description: Unexecuted template (PR-VID-MOTION-410, post-pilot Stage C). Stage C3 start-pose contrast: the same head turn on both subjects with a start-pose-matched driver (facing the camera) and with the pilot's unmatched profile-start driver, baseline arm only (4 jobs) at 81 frames. Compare each subject's two cases to see what a start-pose mismatch does. Bind your own images and driving videos; a physical run needs the owner's separate authorization.

cases.prompt: a woman with long brown hair in polished steel plate armor over dark clothing, standing in a stone archway, upper body, photorealistic

motion.action: Starts facing the camera, turns the head to the subject's left into profile, and holds.
motion.motion_prompt: the person starts facing the camera, slowly turns their head to their left into profile and holds, body and shoulders still
motion.expected_outcome: The intended subject starts facing the camera, their head rotates smoothly to their left into profile and holds there; the opening pose is natural (not already turned far over a shoulder), the shoulders and background stay still and the face is not replaced or duplicated.
motion.direction: to the subject's left (the viewer's right)

annotations.start_pose: facing the camera (the pilot's profile-start driver, trimmed and reversed)

cases.prompt: a woman with long brown hair in polished steel plate armor over dark clothing, standing in a stone archway, upper body, photorealistic

motion.action: Starts looking away in profile, turns the head over the shoulder to face the camera, and holds.
motion.motion_prompt: the person turns their head from profile to look at the camera and holds, body and shoulders still
motion.expected_outcome: The intended subject's head rotates from a profile view to face the camera and holds there; the shoulders and background stay still and the face is not replaced or duplicated. The driver starts in profile while the source faces the camera, so this case shows what a start-pose mismatch does.
motion.direction: from profile to facing the camera

annotations.start_pose: in profile, facing away from the camera (the pilot driver, unchanged); deliberately unmatched to the source
compatibility: start pose NOT matched to the source
